body.statement: Along the retained even tail \(n\ge N_0\), if \(b_n\to b\) and \(s_n\to s\), then \(\sqrt n(\widehat\tau_n-\tau_n)\Rightarrow b^{\mathsf T}C_{k,a}+s\varepsilon\), with \(C_{k,a}\perp\varepsilon\).
body.justification: This is the requested common-statistic limit for the finite-population ATE under the actual terminal assignment.
body.gap: Zhu and Liu prove unbiasedness and a variance-reduction lower bound but explicitly leave this asymptotic distribution to future work.
body.consumer: The theorem turns the original PSRR design into an asymptotically analyzable ATE procedure under heterogeneous effects.
